1.title: Bryan Johnson Wants to Live Forever. But Why?
1.summary: The longevity guru intensely monitors his diet and health. At a dinner party, he was asked about his quest for immortality. There was silence.

2.title: U.S. Citizen Who Deleted Phone’s Data Says His Prosecution Puts Privacy at Risk
2.summary: Samuel Tunick, who faces a felony charge for deleting his phone’s data during an airport customs search, called the government’s peering into people’s private lives “creepy.”

3.title: How Harvard’s Epic Fight With Trump Is Costing the University
3.summary: The federal government has slowed Harvard’s funding, despite the university’s legal victories. The conflict is forcing hard choices on campus.

4.title: Iran Must Plan to Overcome ‘Unjust Sanctions,’ Top Tehran Official Says
4.summary: Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, lead negotiator in talks with the United States, made the comments after President Trump vowed an “economic D-Day” against Iran.

5.title: Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan back in jail after hospital examination
5.summary: It comes as the court had earlier this week ordered that he had to be taken for a hospital examination.

6.title: Bodies of two hikers missing for decades found after Swiss glacier melts
6.summary: Officials say the bodies of the two Belgians, who went missing in 1992, were discovered after the Trift Glacier receded.
